intents_zh: python CLI 像 git 那種 subcommand
python 寫 git 風格 CLI
code:
import argparse

def cmd_{{cmd_a}}(args):
    print('running {{cmd_a}}', args.target)

def cmd_{{cmd_b}}(args):
    print('running {{cmd_b}}', args.target)

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='{{tool_name}}')
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest='cmd', required=True)
    a = sub.add_parser('{{cmd_a}}'); a.add_argument('target'); a.set_defaults(func=cmd_{{cmd_a}})
    b = sub.add_parser('{{cmd_b}}'); b.add_argument('target'); b.set_defaults(func=cmd_{{cmd_b}})
    args = p.parse_args()
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
